issues.where: the two animal bodies/tails in the lower foreground
issues.what: they read as smooth clay or rubber 3D models with a blurry, stretched procedural skin texture, overly uniform silhouettes, and no fine skin detail or wetness from the lake
issues.fix: add high-frequency skin micro-detail, natural anatomical irregularity, and wet sheen or spray matching the lakeside environment

issues.where: the dark emerging mound and surrounding white spikes in the center of the lake
issues.what: the mound looks like a smooth glossy CG blob intersecting the water with no foam, splash, water runoff, or radiating wake, and the white spikes pierce the surface cleanly with no meniscus or ripples
issues.fix: add realistic surface detail to the mound, breaking foam, dripping sheen, and concentric wake ripples around both the mound and each spike

issues.where: the deep blue-teal water on the right and its shoreline against the orange crust
issues.what: the foreground water has no surface reflection, specular glints, or ripples—reading as an invisible void over a blurry stretched diagonal slope that abruptly turns into mirror-like water in the midground—while the crust edge looks like a paper-thin cutout with a thin bright outline and no wet rim or foam
issues.fix: render a continuous water surface with Fresnel reflections, subtle ripples, and refraction across the foreground, and give the crust real thickness, a darkened wet edge, and mineral foam where it meets the water

issues.where: the lake water across all four native crops (and set-B-06.png)
issues.what: the water surface reads as flat, horizontally stretched noise streaks and straight horizontal lines rather than three-dimensional wavelets and organic reflections
issues.fix: replace the stretched horizontal noise with multi-scale 3D wave geometry and normal detail that breaks up reflections naturally

issues.where: the foreground crust in the bottom-right crop (and set-B-03.png left)
issues.what: at native size the shelf is geometrically flat with a soft, smeared procedural orange-and-beige texture that lacks sharp micro-relief, grit, or crusted mineral fractures
issues.fix: add fine displacement, crisp mineral grain, varied roughness between wet and dry patches, and real micro-shadowing

issues.where: the skeleton resting on the crust in the left crop
issues.what: the bones look like smooth, slightly faceted clay meshes sitting on top of a flat plane with weak contact grounding and no mineral crust, wetness, or orange staining tying them to the shelf
issues.fix: add weathered bone porosity and cracks, sharper contact occlusion where bones press into the ground, and matching mineral deposits and dampness along their lower edges

issues.where: the mist band along the base of the far cliffs in the top-left, top-right, and bottom-left crops
issues.what: the vapour reads as a flat, uniform airbrushed grey-white stripe with no wisps, depth variation, or warm golden sunlight scattering from the lit cliffs behind it
issues.fix: replace the uniform mist band with layered volumetric vapour that catches warm sunlight on the lit side and breaks into organic plumes over the water

issues.where: the deep water in the bottom-left crop (x 83 to 100%, y 25 to 42%)
issues.what: the water crushes to near-pure featureless black with faint gradient banding and no sky reflection or surface detail
issues.fix: lift the deepest water with subtle grazing sky reflections, fine surface ripples, and natural water absorption rather than pure black
